question.text:
A $20\text{ ft}$ ladder leans against a vertical wall. The base of the ladder is sliding away from the wall at $2\text{ ft/s}$. A point $P$ on the ladder is $6\text{ ft}$ from the top of the ladder. At the instant when the base is $12\text{ ft}$ from the wall, at what rate is the height of $P$ above the ground changing?

  1. $-\frac{3}{2}\text{ ft/s}$
     
  2. $-\frac{21}{20}\text{ ft/s}$
     
  3. $-\frac{9}{10}\text{ ft/s}$
     
  4. $\frac{21}{20}\text{ ft/s}$
question.subject: Calculus

question.text: Let $f(x)=\left|x-\lfloor x\rfloor-\frac{1}{2}\right|$, where $\lfloor x\rfloor$ denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to $x$. The value of $\int_{0.2}^{2.75} f(x)dx$ is ______, up to $2$ decimal places.
question.subject: Calculus

question.text:
Let $f:[0,1]\to\mathbb{R}$ be continuous and satisfy $f(x)=x^2+\int_0^1 (x+t)f(t)dt$ for every $x\in[0,1]$. Which of the following is $f(x)$?

  1. $x^2-5x-\frac{17}{6}$
     
  2. $x^2+5x+\frac{17}{6}$
     
  3. $x^2-\frac{5}{2}x-\frac{17}{6}$
     
  4. $x^2-5x+\frac{17}{6}$
question.subject: Calculus

question.text:
Evaluate $$I=\int_0^1 \frac{x^2}{(1-x^2)^{3/2}}dx$$

  1. $\frac{\pi}{4}$
     
  2. $1$
     
  3. $2$
     
  4. The integral diverges
question.subject: Calculus

question.text:
Which of the following is the derivative of $f(x)=(x^2+1)^{x\ln x}$ when $x>0$?

  1. $(x^2+1)^{x\ln x}\left((\ln x+1)\ln(x^2+1)+\dfrac{2x^2\ln x}{x^2+1}\right)$
     
  2. $(x^2+1)^{x\ln x}\left(\ln(x^2+1)+\dfrac{2x\ln x}{x^2+1}\right)$
     
  3. $(x^2+1)^{x\ln x}\left(x\ln x+\dfrac{2x}{x^2+1}\right)$
     
  4. $(x^2+1)^{x\ln x}\left((\ln x+1)(x^2+1)+2x\ln x\right)$
question.subject: Calculus
